data.desc: Lithium Argentina owns and actively manages significant interests in large-scale lithium assets, a key material used in the production of lithium-ion batteries, electric vehicles, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). The Company, in partnership with Ganfeng operates the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation in the Jujuy province of Argentina and is advancing PPG in the Salta province of Argentina. Lithium Argentina currently trades on the TSX and on the NYSE under the ticker 'LAR'.
